how: Press Left and Right in turn on the beat, like a very wet cyclist. On the beat is good, near it is fair, and a ragged kick stirs up silt that clogs the snorkel and drains your breath. Confirm blows the snorkel clear, which costs about a beat. Two lengths, 60 yards each, flippers only.

waen_rhydd.name: Waen Rhydd peat bog

rival.who: Bethan, bog snorkelling champion of Powys
rival.intro: Bethan is already in the trench up to her chin, with her flippers on and a face of perfect calm. The water is the colour of strong tea and about as warm as it was at breakfast.
rival.beaten: Bethan pushes her mask up and looks at you for a long moment. Then she says, in Welsh, something that is either a compliment or a question about your family.

waen_rhydd.real: The real thing is the World Bog Snorkelling Championships at Waen Rhydd peat bog, near Llanwrtyd Wells in Powys, held every August bank holiday. Competitors wear flippers and a snorkel, may not use any normal swimming stroke, and swim two lengths of a 60-yard trench cut through the peat. Fancy dress is encouraged.
